newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks sink to new year-low at close.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks sink to new year-low at close.

text.p: Pakistani stocks sagged to hit a new year-low towards the end of trading on Monday mainly on short-selling in select blue chips and brokers said they expect a further slide in the absence of any positive news.
The Karachi 100-share index fell 11.09 points, or 0.81 percent, to end at 1,351.92. Losers beat gainers 150 to 70.

"Short-sellers dragged down the index," a dealer at KASB & Co said. "Sentiment is weak owing to political and economic problems and there is no good news to shake-off the gloom." PTCL fell 0.40 rupees to 33.60 and Fauji Fertilizer 3.10 to 63.35.
